*Topics — What a work is about. Nucleation holds whatever reading the owner files here, whether or not an Anthology of the SOTA topic could also hold it; instruction for ML practice belongs to the anthology (ADR-048). **Self-governance** — governing oneself by standards that are one's own — identification and wholeheartedness, planning agency and policies, self-constitution, autonomy and authenticity, and the empirical psychology of self-endorsed motives. One of four unities kept apart (group: philosophy; ADR-024).

| [CASE-346](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-346.md) v2 | The self-protecting sentry, run | [LEAD-076](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-076.md) asked for [CASE-153](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-153.md)'s full design, with hidden state and the restriction of evidence, which [CASE-157](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-157.md)'s run and the toy in [CASE-153](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-153.md)'s note of 2026-11-04 did not have. A hidden world is dangerous for 150 steps, safe for 400 and dangerous for 100. Each step the agent inspects (accuracy 0.9, cost 0.05) or shelters (no observation), then protects (cost 1) or engages (cost 5 if dangerous). A sentry's authority g biases posture toward protection and, where evidence is restricted, blocks inspection. Over 1000 paired seeds per condition, the Bayesian baseline leaves protection about 3 steps after the switch. When authority is rewarded by the apparent success of protection and the sentry restricts inspection, no run leaves protection in 400 safe steps and 43 % of runs never even correct the belief. Restriction costs 99 [95, 103] units of needless protection more under success feedback than under independent evaluation. An independent audit lets 66 % of runs leave. A protected investigator corrects the belief within a median 6 steps, yet protection outlasts it in 87 % of runs, the regime [CASE-153](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-153.md) asked for. Every regime still protects when danger returns. The case's own check comes out against the authority state: under success feedback its update is the habit of protecting, and a habit of matched memory reproduces the responses to belief correction, authority reset and restored evidence. Only interventions on the evaluation tell the two apart. The phase boundary lies near sentry strength κ = 1.25–1.5 and moves with the assumed switching hazard. The model and its values are the assistant's. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Active |
| [CASE-348](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-348.md) | A collective improving its own improver | [LEAD-140](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-140.md) asked for [CASE-255](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-255.md) to be run. A reduced version was simulated on [CASE-332](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-332.md)'s organization (scratch/studies/lead-140/). The organization's procedures are the artifact; a hill-climbing improver with settings and a record of past moves changes them; in four arms the collective also changes the improver, judging each change by the public metric, by its own suite, by an outside suite, or by its own suite with an outside veto on weakened verification. 6 arms × 12 lineages × 60 generations; then each lineage's earlier and later improver applied to the same fresh artifact at equal budget, and the later improver's evaluation suite lesioned. The later improver did better from the same start in every adaptive arm (+0.010 to +0.017 on the held-out score; p = 0.02 and 0.007 in the outside and vetoed arms). The gain lay in its settings (more candidates, reading its record); the record alone, handed to an improver that does not read it, carried nothing. Judged by the public metric, by its own suite or by an outside test of products, 1 or 2 lineages in 12 shed the artifact's self-check, and 2 to 5 shed the improver's own canary; the vetoed arm shed neither from its artifacts, a difference too small to be significant. With the canary removed and the suite lesioned, a record-blind improver dropped the artifact's self-check in 10 of 12 lineages and one that reads its record in 0 of 12. Much follows from the stated rules. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
| [CASE-355](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-355.md) | Registered evaluation in synthetic organizations | [LEAD-017](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-017.md) asked for A13's three organizations of matched behaviour and different endorsement relations, and a measure of registration that does not read the experimenter's setting ([QUESTION-270](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-270.md)'s second requirement). In small numpy simulations an outcome's hedonic value declines progressively from +1 to −0.8. A consummatory process H evaluates it, and pursuit P keeps choosing it at a calibrated rate of 0.6 in all three organizations. In the denied organization H's evaluation is written into the organization's record and has no authority over pursuit. In the accommodating one it is written and has authority beyond a tolerance that reciprocal compensation widens. In the unregistered one it is never written. The record is mixed by an unknown rotation and noisy. The measure perturbs H's evaluation at random, as a hotspot probe would, and asks whether the record responds, holding fixed the outcome, the action and P's learned value. With thresholds set on one seed, on 200 held-out agents per organization it called every registered agent registered and no unregistered one (AUC 1.0). It was not fooled by a decoy record carrying the evaluation's physiological cause by another route (2% false calls, against 77% for the passive reading), nor by an evaluation that steers pursuit directly, bypassing the record (1.5%). It missed weak registration (gain 0.1 to 0.25) in 60% of agents. The authority probe told accommodation from denial in 43% of agents at 4.5% false calls. A stipulated model, one size, one probe protocol. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |

These let the comparison be stated as a matched pair: tolerance sustained by the offspring's own persisting maternal cells, against tolerance sustained by matched tolerogenic cells given later from a donor. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
| [CASE-363](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-363.md) v2 | Meaning–influence model in mean field | The build [LEAD-090](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-090.md) asks for. [CASE-092](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-092.md)'s model is written as an agent-level simulation (two hypotheses, a fixed corpus, two specialists, queries framed by the dominant interpretation with exploration, conferral from apparent retrieval success under Regime A or B) and reduced to its mean field in meaning m and authority a. Its linearization at symmetry is [CASE-099](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-099.md)'s with α = 1 − ρ(1 − φ′), β = ρσ, γ = (1 − δ)gσ/2, so [CLAIM-330](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-330.md)'s condition becomes gσ² > 2(1 − φ′): the meaning rate and the conferral memory cancel, and the fixed points are those of a Curie–Weiss equation. The reduced map equals, to 1e-12, a weighted-averaging model with two stubborn sources whose weights relax toward an agreement kernel; on a balanced corpus that kernel is Gaussian bounded confidence. Fixed-weight DeGroot and Friedkin–Johnsen, and the reflected-appraisal power maps of DeGroot–Friedkin and Friedkin 2011, cannot make the winner of authority depend on the initial interpretation, and none of them, nor Gaussian bounded confidence, lets corpus imbalance switch authority with hysteresis; the reduced model does both. A fictional model, by construction; the numbers are of this model. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Active |

Two copies of [CASE-363](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-363.md)'s reduced institution, an evaluator E and an evaluated party P, read the same two hypotheses and are coupled through four named channels: the party's prevailing interpretation tilts the evidence the evaluator reads (θ) and the authority inside it (ω); the evaluator's reading is evidence the party reads (χ) and redistributes authority inside the party (ψ). [CLAIM-404](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-404.md)'s loop, in A21's words, is θ and ψ. Linearized at the symmetric state, the 4×4 Jacobian is unstable exactly when the round-trip gain (θ + σ_E ω)(χ + σ_P ψ)/(Δ_E Δ_P) exceeds 1, Δ_i = (1 − φ′_i) − g_iσ_i²/2 being each institution's own margin; the meaning rates and conferral memories cancel. 1,802 of 1,802 random parameter sets agreed with the nonlinear map. The evaluator's reading is captured with its own authority untouched when its conferral reads no interpretation; cutting the return channel removes the instability whatever the party supplies. Resources read as capacity rather than direction leave the linear condition unchanged and capture one side below it. A fictional model, by construction; the numbers are of this model. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Active |
| [CASE-415](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-415.md) v2 | Four governance architectures, federated | [LEAD-180](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-180.md) asked for [CASE-108](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-108.md) to be run. A small federated learner (scratch/studies/lead-180/) has a main block of tasks every specialist's data covers and a minority block only 3 honest dissenters' data covers; the 14 cooperatives misjudge it, and 3 adversaries farm for 100 rounds, then attack the main block (overt) or the minority block (mimic, looking like dissent). Unrestricted, two reliability-weighted, role-limited and adaptive aggregation, and an oracle, over 30 seeds. Role-limited audit, in which evaluators with their own validation evidence vote only on the blocks they hold evidence for, cut attack success to about 0 for both attacks and raised minority capability from 0.27 to 0.92, for 0.01 of main capability and 120 evaluations a round. Reputation by agreement was captured by the mimic attack (attack success 0.39, unrestricted 0.30); reputation by validation without jurisdiction stopped the overt attack and left the minority where unrestricted aggregation leaves it. With 2 of 7 evaluators compromised, role-limited audit let the mimic attack through (0.27) and cut the dissenters' influence from 4.2 to 0.9 times parity; the adaptive arm held it to 0.10 with an honest monitor and did no better than role-limited with a compromised one, which suspended every dissenter. With no evidence on the minority block independent of the proposals, attack success in a world and in its relabelling (dissenters' and attackers' targets swapped) summed to 1 for every architecture. Much follows from the stated rules. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Active |

Critic weights (whose evidence one reads) are scored by agreement, by observed relevance, or a mix; decision grants set authority under one-hop, leave-one-out or recursive aggregation, and operators move them for realized policy or for authority held. Five grant schemes and six grant games, on 30 populations, in mean field and at agent level. Role indexing with the critic role scored by relevance leaves no factions and no capture; scalar grants fail either way; operators bound by both conditions delegate everything, all of it to their own side, beyond one hop too, and within their side to its extremes. A fictional model, by construction; the numbers are of this model. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Active |
